hero.title: Cost Platform
hero.description: Consolidated 100+ fragmented financial services into a single, unified ReactJS platform for 20K+ internal users, replacing legacy SAP Fiori within a 6-month timeframe.

sections.title: UX Research & Discovery
paragraphs: The project initiated with comprehensive user research. Over a two-year period, we gathered more than 2,000 feedback submissions through biannual surveys. Users consistently reported low satisfaction with the legacy SAP Fiori tiled interface, noting that substantial time was lost searching for the correct financial services.

Our baseline metrics highlighted critical usability challenges: a user satisfaction score (Top-2) of 54% (against an 80% target) and a bottom-2 dissatisfaction rate of 25% (target 5%). The directive was clear: unify these fragmented workflows into a cohesive ReactJS platform.

sections.title: Architecture & Navigation Complexity
paragraphs: A primary challenge was consolidating over 100 distinct financial services—each featuring its own disparate system architecture—into a single platform. We collaborated closely with business analysts to design a robust role-based access model, ensuring users only saw services relevant to their specific permissions.
To prevent cognitive overload, we restricted the navigation structure to a maximum of two nesting levels, successfully categorizing the 100+ services into 10 logical, intuitive groups.

sections.title: Wireframing & Prototyping
paragraphs: Our design strategy incorporated proven patterns from industry best practices: clean layouts from modern HR systems, robust category navigation from support portals, and card-based views familiar to legacy Fiori users.

We built interactive prototypes of the light theme using Framer and tested them with a control user group. Based on their feedback, we optimized information density and layout spacing to ensure readability on smaller desktop screens.

sections.title: Design System & Grids
paragraphs: As the sole designer for a platform of this scale, I adopted Material Design with custom brand styling. This enabled the development team to build services rapidly without design bottlenecks.

Accessibility was a priority: I derived three adaptive shades from our primary brand color to ensure compliance with WCAG contrast standards. In addition, we utilized CSS linters to maintain design system and layout purity.

sections.title: Responsive Web & Mobile Layouts
paragraphs: The platform was built on strict principles of responsive design using CSS Flexbox and Grid. While the initial focus was on the desktop web platform (released in 2021) as core services operated in the internal domain, we established a clear roadmap for native mobile applications in 2022. Both Light and Dark modes were fully specified.

sections.title: Final Result & Impact
paragraphs: Within six months, we launched the platform to production. A follow-up survey of 267 pilot users revealed a significant improvement in user sentiment. Users praised the boost in operational speed, the clean interface, and the streamlined efficiency of interacting with the financial services.

keyAchievements: Designed a scalable navigation structure constrained to 2 levels.
